evidence_quotes: Generator records SHALL use explicit class/version and typed variants with separate ownership for requests, inventories, controls, generated assets, Execution Records and authored content. Each requested asset SHALL have its own identity, kind, requiredness and purpose, resolving to one produced, omitted or unresolved disposition; produced SHALL reference actual matching assets while unresolved SHALL NOT fabricate output identities or digests. Provider-local handles SHALL NOT mint presentation or kernel identities: a trusted recorded authoring operation SHALL issue opaque presentation identities with retained provenance, without claiming human adoption. Serialized editorial/profile flags SHALL NOT replace effective owner-act evaluation. Canonical anchors SHALL use RFC7-10's target-specific identity, fragment and state representation, distinguishing artifact revision from kernel evaluation and verbatim label/tier/reason. PWB wire conventions SHALL be preserved through explicit compatibility adaptation, never silently promoted into a generic schema or used to widen source admission. Unsupported adaptation SHALL remain explicit without invented identity/state. Required internal references SHALL resolve; definitions SHALL be unique, support references SHALL belong to their claim block, and ownership/containment and stage-input graphs SHALL be acyclic. Supported factual relationship cycles and glossary cross-reference cycles SHALL remain representable. Validation SHALL reject duplicate object keys, unknown interchange versions/kinds, undeclared effect-bearing fields and exceeded structural/content bounds without silent truncation. Shape validity SHALL NOT establish authority, fidelity, readiness or authorship. Newer unsupported plane versions SHALL forbid writes/downgrade and render uninterpretable content Unknown; older content SHALL use declared compatibility paths without mutation on read. Persistent migration SHALL require its own reviewed, attributed, atomic and reversible act, preserving the identities, meanings and citation resolution protected by RFC3-23; OpenSpec content SHALL remain outside that migration authority.

evidence_quotes:
- **Complete tuple.** Every project entity and project-fact claim SHALL have a
  stable semantic Claim identity plus an evaluation instance, be challengeable
  with resolvable support, and carry the closed label, tier, exactly one
  primary reason, zero or more closed secondary reasons, freshness, challenge
  state and evaluation identity that govern it.
  - Unknown reasons SHALL use RFC2-24 values verbatim and expose their
    resolution routes.

- **Aggregates.** Aggregates SHALL disclose label, tier, freshness and
  separate primary/secondary reason counts without a headline status,
  composite maturity or inferred success.
  - Default Polaris status presentation SHALL not render trends, metric walls
    or count walls; coverage counts remain available on demand.

- **Oracle**: compare each tuple and tier meaning to independent literal
  vocabularies and provenance-verified currency inputs; verify stable semantic
  identity across the two evaluation instances; exhaust challenge/sibling
  separation, aggregate label/tier/freshness/reason counts and supports links;
  decide each dismissal record against each evaluation's own as-of instant
  with the checker's own statement of the rule; zero invalid, missing or
  folded values decides.

changed_entries.heading: PWB-REQ-014 — Every narrative claim is bounded, anchored and non-authoritative
changed_entries.input_boundary: Narrative claim/anchor/group/review-record populations and the machine answer own-identity record census at the same evaluation.
changed_entries.output_and_oracle_boundary: Exact anchorsResolved pairs, identity-versus-reference distinction, safe diagrams and non-authoritative openings/claims.
changed_entries.reason: The anchor resolver reads machine-answer bytes and must distinguish new local reference objects from records with their own identity. Its complete input graph changes while the legitimate identity population must remain fixed.
changed_entries.method: Read all anchor shape/resolution, tree opening, diagram, SVG/sink and withholding-identity cases. Incoming: the altered machine record/reference structure. Outgoing: own-identity census -> exact anchor-resolution pairs. The literal ref is not an identity; retained Dolt-observation and project-shape targets keep their own identities. This is compatibility work, not a new anchor target.
changed_entries.semantic_disposition: Affected-compatible. Keep the complete block, exact identity definition, captured tuples and non-authority semantics; no text invalidation identified.
changed_entries.later_verification_obligation: Independently census own-identity records from the new answer, reject treating refs/composed identities as records, and reproduce all block/narrative pairs and identity-withholding cases. Confirm no new aggregate/claim identity, target drift or active SVG reaches a sink.
changed_entries.c3_reason: Owns narrative roles, anchors, non-authority and captured target state. P115 does not pool anchors or projectShape/kernel records and supplies no narrative warrant.
changed_entries.c3_method: Authored assessment of this block's normative behavior and owned input/output scope against the proposed workItems-only carrier, preserved identity/populations/records and explicit exclusions; full block digest and source excerpt retained. Declaration and full-text signals are supporting observations, never an absence-of-edge proof.
changed_entries.consumption: Narrative claim/anchor/group/review-record populations and the machine answer own-identity record census at the same evaluation. -> Exact anchorsResolved pairs, identity-versus-reference distinction, safe diagrams and non-authoritative openings/claims.
evidence_quotes:
- **Anchor resolution count.** The machine narrative SHALL carry an
  `anchorsResolved` pair on each anchored claim block, and one for the whole
  narrative: the number of anchors that resolve, over the number of anchors.
  - An anchor resolves when the machine answer at the same evaluation serves
    exactly one record with an `identity` field of its own whose whole value
    equals the anchor's target identity. A field that refers to another
    record's identity, such as a stamp's or a support's source identity, is a
    reference and not a record's own identity, and an identity composed from
    other fields counts for nothing. An anchor whose target the machine answer
    does not serve, or serves without an identity of its own, does not
    resolve.
  - This resolution runs from an anchor to a record of the machine answer. It
    is not the relation RFC7-3 forbids, under which something resolves to
    Polaris as its authority.
  - Both numbers are counted, never estimated, and the narrative's pair is
    the sum of its blocks' pairs. A count below its total SHALL be served as
    counted, never rounded up, omitted or rendered as a pass. When the machine
    answer at that evaluation serves no record with an identity of its own,
    every pair is Unknown with its reason, never a count.
  - The pair counts resolution and never confers authority. A block whose
    every anchor resolves stays `presentation-artifact` and `non-citable`;
    no field derived from the pair SHALL make a narrative unit citable or
    stand in for an epistemic label. The pair is itself presentation: no
    evidence, snapshot input or status claim SHALL take it as input.
  - An opening carries no anchor set, so it carries no pair and the
    narrative's pair counts nothing for it.
  - The pair is a machine-narrative field, not a project-shape claim, and
    Polaris need not render it.

- **Oracle**: independent claim-to-source mapping establishes covering,
  minimality, closed target class, durable identity, exact narrative-vs-kernel
  machine type and captured target state; removing any used anchor fails one
  claim and adding an unused anchor fails surplus; a later-read mutation cannot
  rewrite the captured state; a complete downstream-reference scan has zero
  Polaris authority targets; deletion leaves truth unchanged and injected
  personal state never enters the truth model. Every opening states nothing
  its children do not, carries its weakest child's label and names its scope
  when partial; every drawn element maps to one machine claim with an equal
  tuple; every listed element not drawn is named with its reason; every
  emitted SVG passes the allow-list, and each excluded construct, injected
  alone, keeps that diagram out of both sinks. PWB-REQ-006's sink scan admits
  an emitted SVG only when the independent allow-list scan passes it. Every
  anchor carries every field of the one shape, and its identity begins with
  the identity of the block that serves it followed by `#`. An independent
  resolver that reads only the machine narrative's anchors and the machine
  answer's bytes at the same evaluation, and imports no rendering code,
  reproduces each block's `anchorsResolved` pair and the narrative's pair
  exactly; withholding one resolved target's identity lowers the resolved
  count of exactly the blocks anchored to it, by the number of their anchors
  that name it, and every such block stays non-citable; withholding every
  identity turns every pair Unknown.

changed_entries.heading: PWB-REQ-020 — Project-wide facts remain identical across human and machine views
changed_entries.input_boundary: The authenticated same-evaluation machine answer, human project-shape parity markers and the closed derived read-only machine views.
changed_entries.output_and_oracle_boundary: Independent multiplicity-preserving parity, derivation from answer-own bytes, complete fact set, credential/mount gates and per-view byte ceilings.
changed_entries.reason: The reference form changes the answer-own byte representation that independent derived-view/recoverability checkers consume. Closed facts may remain the same without making this obligation untied.
changed_entries.method: Read the full category/membership/ceiling, generated-editorial view, recoverability and mutation limbs. Incoming: complete re-encoded answer and validated same-evaluation values. Outgoing: own-byte derivability and subtraction-free fact preservation -> each named view, plus parity; /polaris/draft is separately run-byte-owned. Current presentation projection may be disjoint, but that does not narrow the general obligation.
changed_entries.semantic_disposition: Affected-compatible; preserve all categories, routes, complete facts, provenance/multiplicity and existing ceilings. No new route/member or textual amendment is required.
changed_entries.later_verification_obligation: Independently prove each currently supported derived value from the new answer at that evaluation, retain full machine facts, both mount credentials and existing per-view bounds. Do not assume a derived view shrinks merely because /api/poc encoding changes; draft-run byte ownership remains separate.
changed_entries.c3_reason: Explicit recoverability scope is projectShape parity markers and authority/judgment disclosures. P115 changes only workItems governedBy carriers, outside those multisets; existing per-item/project claim records remain separate.
changed_entries.c3_method: Authored assessment of this block's normative behavior and owned input/output scope against the proposed workItems-only carrier, preserved identity/populations/records and explicit exclusions; full block digest and source excerpt retained. Declaration and full-text signals are supporting observations, never an absence-of-edge proof.
changed_entries.consumption: The authenticated same-evaluation machine answer, human project-shape parity markers and the closed derived read-only machine views. -> Independent multiplicity-preserving parity, derivation from answer-own bytes, complete fact set, credential/mount gates and per-view byte ceilings.
evidence_quotes:
- **Derived read-only machine views.** A **derived read-only machine view**
  composes only values already reachable from the machine answer at the same
  evaluation, mints no project fact, writes nothing, is served only to
  machine-credentialed clients in every mount form, and subtracts nothing: the
  complete fact set stays served by the machine answer at that same
  evaluation.
  - Every value such a view serves SHALL be independently verified as
    derivable from the machine answer's own bytes at that evaluation, by a
    checker that imports no rendering code.
  - The members of this category are the Polaris presentation view,
    `GET /api/poc/polaris`, served under the machine-JSON ceiling the
    adapter-registry entry already declares, and the agent briefing view,
    `GET /api/poc/briefing`, served under a byte ceiling of its own.

- **Membership.** A member served under a byte ceiling of its own SHALL NOT be
  served before the adapter-registry entry's resource envelope declares that
  ceiling.
  - A route enters either category only by a later amendment to this
    specification naming it as a member.
  - A route in neither category is neither admitted nor forbidden by this
    requirement.

- **Recoverability.** Every project-shape identity, statement, source anchor,
  coverage state, denominator, contradiction, body-read authority state and
  walkthrough-judgment state or disclosure Polaris presents SHALL be
  recoverable from the same evaluation in the machine answer, preserving
  multiplicity and exact provenance state.

Outgoing: readiness false for a breach, without an owner judgment or PWB022 invalid arm. Separately bounded the candidate invalid-reference readiness:false as a response-level no-model refusal, not a retained new readiness predicate.

Wire faults may return readiness:false only as refusal payload; if implementation persists a new model-readiness arm, stop for an explicit PWB021 companion rather than silently treating it as an existing arm.
changed_entries.c3_reason: Requires owner cold-open comprehension answers and retained explanations. P115 changes no prompts, answer identities, source routes or walkthrough execution state.
changed_entries.c3_method: Authored assessment of this block's normative behavior and owned input/output scope against the proposed workItems-only carrier, preserved identity/populations/records and explicit exclusions; full block digest and source excerpt retained. Declaration and full-text signals are supporting observations, never an absence-of-edge proof.
changed_entries.consumption: Exact nine retained answers and readiness arms, including any PWB006 resource breach, evaluated against exact surface/evaluation and paths/current authority. -> Machine/owner-visible readiness, never a comprehension verdict; retained 84+2 PWB022 act-validity population.
evidence_quotes:
- **Readiness.** Readiness SHALL be false for a missing, empty, duplicate or
  unrecognized answer identity; an unresolved source anchor; a
  surface/evaluation mismatch; any path outside Polaris or its same-evaluation
  exact-source route; any PWB-REQ-006 resource breach; or an answer whose
  cited current Butlers authority cannot be resolved.
  - Readiness and the nine answers SHALL be machine-readable and owner-visible
    but SHALL remain execution facts, never a verdict or proof of
    comprehension.
  - The implementation SHALL NOT score or decide the semantic correctness of
    the owner's own-words answers.
  - That comparison informs only the separate human owner judgment and
    rationale.

- **Relation to PWB-REQ-022.** These readiness cases belong only to
  PWB-REQ-021.
  - They SHALL NOT be added to, substituted for or treated as invalid arms in

The new fields must not duplicate the Dolt revision/capture whole value or authorize a second source read.

evidence_quotes:
- **One statement of provenance.** The observation so served SHALL state its
  provenance once, as one record in the shape each element of the machine
  answer's entity and relationship provenance lists takes, and that record
  names the Dolt revision. No other field of the observation, its own or a
  work-item fact's, SHALL hold the Dolt revision as its whole value.

    second half of the observation's identity. It is not a second statement
    of provenance.
  - Every served work-item fact carries that revision as provenance by
    belonging to the observation. No work-item fact SHALL carry a field whose
    whole value is the observation's Dolt revision, or carry the capture
    instant in any field other than a time the database itself records for
    that item.

  against the database's own head revision queried directly, and a
  sampled item's fields against a direct SQL read at that revision;
  equality decides. Over every field of the served observation, compare
  each whole value against the Dolt revision and the capture instant:
  exactly one field holds the Dolt revision, the provenance record's, and
  exactly one holds the capture instant, the observation's own, leaving
  out each item's created, updated and closed times, which the database
  records; an exhausted sweep decides.
